chat.text: I need the traceability handoff to stay clean from field picking through bin labeling and Wash Station A intake.
The key handoff is: full bin at roughly 250 lb, crew lead labels immediately, AgriTrace Pro scan verifies the bin, and Wash Station A handles intake or quarantine.
I will check the crew flow for a minute. If a handoff card would help, prepare it.

selectedFacts.label: full bin rule
selectedFacts.displayText: A standard yellow macro bin is considered full when peaches are level with the top rim, about 250 lb, and must move to block-end staging within 15 minutes.
selectedFacts.relevance: Supports the full bin row and field handoff timing.

selectedFacts.label: label ownership
selectedFacts.displayText: The crew lead generates the QR traceability label immediately after a bin is full; the ID format is VV-YYMMDD-BLOCK-BIN# and the label goes on the north-facing side, 5 inches from the top-right corner.
selectedFacts.relevance: Supports the label row and placement details.

selectedFacts.label: AgriTrace Pro scan
selectedFacts.displayText: Labels are generated in AgriTrace Pro, and a QR scan reveals block of origin, crop, crew lead, and exact labeling timestamp.
selectedFacts.relevance: Supports scan evidence without updating the system.

selectedFacts.label: Wash Station A intake
selectedFacts.displayText: Sofia Rossi manages Wash Station A and must scan each bin QR code before tipping it into the hydro-cooler; successful intake scan logs Washed status.

selectedFacts.label: Traceability Hold
selectedFacts.displayText: Any bin without a scannable label moves immediately to Quarantine Bay Q2 and is flagged for Traceability Hold.
selectedFacts.relevance: Supports exception handling and safety boundary.

selectedFacts.label: delay and correction
selectedFacts.displayText: AgriTrace Pro alerts if field scan to wash station scan exceeds 90 minutes; mislabeled bins require an incident report and correct re-labeling within 10 minutes.

selectedFacts.label: pallet source links
selectedFacts.displayText: Packing creates pallet lots by scanning all source bin QR codes and using a final master QR code linking to source bin IDs.
selectedFacts.relevance: Supports downstream traceability without changing shipment status.
